description: Pause until a condition is met.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

for.description: 'stable' = DOM stops mutating, 'network' = 0 pending requests. 'auto' tries to guess.

tab_id.description: Execute in a specific tab instead of active.

value.description: CSS selector, text string, or URL pattern. Not needed for 'stable'/'network'.

name: browser_wait
